title: Retain immutable causal memory keys and frozen codebooks across replay
observation: EngramStore retains aliases to caller context; FrozenQuantizer's read-only flag can be reversed, and deepcopy/restore does not preserve a true immutable buffer.
cause: Read-only ndarray flags and np.asarray views do not establish immutable snapshot ownership.
severity: incorrect arithmetic, state or evidence admission on valid/ambiguous boundary inputs
implemented_change: Use immutable byte-backed key/codebook snapshots, a read-only centers property and deepcopy preservation. Validate memory capacity and key/value admission before eviction, and make recent(0) empty.
predicted_consequence: New constructed regressions fail on the recorded parent and pass after the repair while the existing bounded suite passes.
